topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which fundamental accounting assumption states that "A business is assumed to continue its business for the foreseeable future
e: Correct answer: Going Concern (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Shilpa wants to choose the method of depreciation, under which the amount of depreciation charged decreases every year?

I. Reducing Balance Method
II. Revaluation Method
III. Straight Line Method
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements is/are true about Ledger?

I. Ledger is the basis of preparing the final accounts
II. The debit and credit balance of a ledger account is always same at any given point
III. Ledgers are known as books of final entry
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
In which of the following cases will Ind AS 104 not apply?

I. Contingent consideration payable or receivable in business combination
II. Direct insurance contract that an entity holds
III. Reinsurance contracts that an entity holds
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The going concern concept refers to a presumption that:

I. The entity will be profitable in the coming year
II. The entity will continue to operate in the foreseeable future
III. Top management of the entity will not change in the coming year
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Tanmay's bank reconciliation statement revealed that cheques deposited but not credited by the bank amounted to Rs.1,900. Cheques issued but not presented for payment amounted to Rs.1,750. The balance according to the bank statement is Rs.12,500(credit). What is the balance according to the cash book?
e: Correct answer: Rs.12,650 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Depreciation is arrived at by deducting the ____________ from the historical cost and then dividing the difference thus determined by the number of years of useful life
e: Correct answer: Scrap Value (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following statements are incorrect regarding the golden rules of accounting ?
o: A transaction is recorded as a 'debit entry' (Dr.)
The golden rules imply the rules of debit and cred
As per the golden rules we need to credit what comes in and debit what goes out for all accounts
The process of debiting and crediting accounts is
As per the golden rules we need to credit the give
e: Correct answer: As per the golden rules we need to credit what comes in and debit what goes out for all accounts (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: When the auditor says that financial statements are true and fair in respect of a matter. What is this opinion known as?
e: Correct answer: Unmodified opinion (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
In the financial statements of a general insurance company, a liability for outstanding claims shall be brought to account in respect of:-

I. Direct business
II. Inward reinsurance business
III. Outward reinsurance business
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Suzan paid a bank loan of Rs.50,000. Which of the following is the correct effect upon the accounting equation?

I. Decrease in asset by Rs.50,000 and increase in liability by Rs.50,000
II. Increase in asset by Rs.50,000 and decrease in liability by Rs.50,000
III. Decrease in asset and liability by Rs.50,000
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A Bank reconciliation statement reconciles the:

I. Ledger with a journal
II. Petty cash book with bank accounts
III. Day books with banks statements
o: Neither I, nor II, nor III
e: Correct answer: Neither I, nor II, nor III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What is the entry for providing depreciation at the end of the accounting period on any Machinery?
o: Profit and Loss Account ..Dr. Depreciation Account
e: Correct answer: Depreciation Account ..Dr.Machinery Account ..Cr. (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The chief accountant of ABC Insurance has performed a wrong valuation of investments deliberately. This is an example of ________.
e: Correct answer: False accounting entries (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd. buys goods from XYZ Ltd. on credit terms. Which of XYZ Ltd.'s books shall be effected by this transaction?
e: Correct answer: Sales Day Book (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following is/are valid purpose of investment for an insurance company?

I. To meet an unforeseen contingencies
II. To earn income on the policyholder's funds
III. To maintain solvency for payments of claims
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If an auditor while conducting an audit was unable to obtain sufficient and appropriate audit evidence in respect of matters which are material but not pervasive to the financial statements. Which kind of opinion would the auditor give?
e: Correct answer: Qualified opinion (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A general insurance company has Motor Third Party Claims where court summons have been served on the Company without adequate policy particulars. To establish liability the Company, shall create how much provision for the estimated liability, where such claims are outstanding for more than one year.
e: Correct answer: 100% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following are not part of the profit and loss account?

I. Sales
II. Debtors
III. Rent
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are correct for single entry accounting system?

I. Some transactions are recorded on both sides
II. Some transactions are recorded on one side
III. Some transactions are not recorded at all
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Where a company has three directors, the maximum remuneration payable to all of them should not exceed ________ of the annual net profit.
e: Correct answer: 10% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: An auditor was auditing the inventory of XYZ Ltd., trader in garments. The management was unable to provide challans and invoices with respect to a consignment of garments imported by the company. The value of the consignment of the garments  is material and will affect the financial statements pervasively. What kind of opinion should the auditors express in their audit report?
e: Correct answer: Disclaimer of opinion (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Deepak is confused as to which of the following costs are not included in the original (total) cost of a fixed asset. Please help him.
o: Stamp duty or import duty paid for acquiring the a
Cost of the maintenance team that looks after the asset
e: Correct answer: Cost of the maintenance team that looks after the asset (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Use the following information to calculate the cash flow from operating activities. Book Profit - Rs. 11,000 Depreciation charges -  Rs. 3,000 Proceeds of sale of fixed assets - Rs. 450,                     Increase in stock - Rs. 490 Increase in creditors - Rs. 550.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 14,060 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following correctly describes the cash maintained under imprest system for operating petty cash?

I. All expenditure out of petty cash must be supported by a properly authorised voucher
II. A regular equal amount of cash is transferred into petty cash
III. The exact amount of expenditure out of petty cash is reimbursed at intervals
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Arion Insurance Ltd purchased a assets on 15 January 2015. Suggest the accountant the depreciation applicable?
o: No depreciation needs to be provided
The rates suggested by management of company
Should be provided on a proportionate basis
e: Correct answer: Half the rates applicable (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which one of the following statements is true about the International Practices in respect of recognition of premium?

I. Written premiums should comprise the total premiums receivable for the whole period of cover provided by a policy during an accounting period
II. If written premiums are subject to a reduction, an adjustment for such a reduction shall be made as soon as it can be foreseen
III. The estimate of pipeline premiums shall relate only to those contracts of insurance where the period of cover has commenced after the balance sheet date.
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following business can be grouped under the broad category of Miscellaneous Insurance Business?

I. Automobile insurance
II. Marine Hull insurance
III. Fidelity insurance
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: How is the gross profit in a trading account calculated?
e: Correct answer: Sales - (Opening Stock + Purchases - Closing Stock (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
With regards to accounting of a general insurance company which of the following statement/s is/are correct?

I. Premium income is accounted for in Revenue Account on a gross premium basis
II. Claims are accounted for as incurred claims and not paid claims
III. Premium income is accounted for at the time of receiving cash
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements is/are incorrect?

I. There are formal standards set for the reporting systems for the internal audit function
II. The Internal auditors should report to the finance manager
III. The internal auditors should verify that management has taken immediate action for rectification of mistakes, wrongs and irregularities reported
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Alpha Ltd prepares the financial statement for the year ending on 31 March 2014. The auditor give their report by 15 May 2014 and it has been finalized and approved by the Board on 15 June 2014 and adopted by the AGM on 5 September 2014. Suggest the period which qualifies for events after balance sheet date as per AS4?
e: Correct answer: 1 April 2014 to 15 June 2014 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The converged Indian accounting standards with IFRS standards will be termed as ________.
e: Correct answer: Ind AS (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following event would normally qualify as adjusting event according to AS 4?

I. Insolvency of a customer whose balance is outstanding on the balance sheet date
II. Decline in market value of investments
III. Issue of shares for cash
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What is the role of an intermediary?
o: Intermediary ensures smooth flow of the reinsuranc
Intermediary lends himself to the sensitive handling of reciprocal reinsurance negotiations and placement for reinsurance protections
Intermediary lends himself to the placement for re
e: Correct answer: Intermediary lends himself to the sensitive handling of reciprocal reinsurance negotiations and placement for reinsurance protections (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Discount earned at the time of lending through Collateralised Borrowing and Lending Obligation is shown as ____________, which is apportioned on time basis.
e: Correct answer: Income (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are correct?

I. Purchase day book is a primary book
II. Trial balance is an account
III. Double entry system is an unscientific method
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: When the Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS) is prepared taking Cash Book as the starting point then how are uncollected cheques treated?
o: They are added in the BRS
They are subtracted in the BRS
They are not required to be adjusted
They can either be added or subtracted
They are treated as bad debts in BRS
e: Correct answer: They are subtracted in the BRS (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
ABC Ltd. Issued 1,000 equity shares at a face value of Rs. 10 per share and a premium of Rs. 2 per share to be paid along with application money. The Company received application, allotment and call money form all shareholders except one holding 50 shares. This shareholder failed to pay the call money and the company forfeited his shares. To which account shall the company transfer the share premium received on these forfeited shares.

I. Securities Premium Account
II. Capital Reserve Account
III. Share Capital Account
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Bank overdraft as per cash book is ________.
e: Correct answer: Credit balance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd. is constructing a fixed asset. Following are the expenses incurred on the construction: Materials Rs. 100 lakhs Direct Expenses Rs. 25 lakhs Total Direct Labour Rs. 50 lakhs (1/10<SUP>th</SUP> of the total labour time was chargeable to the construction) Total office & administrative expenses Rs. 80 lakhs (5% is chargeable to the construction) Depreciation on the assets used for the construction of this assets Rs. 1 lakh. Calculate the cost of fixed assets.
e: Correct answer: Rs.135 lakhs (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: When in a reinsurance arrangement there is no pre-determined ratio for dividing the premiums and losses between the direct insurer and the reinsurer. What is this type of reinsurance termed as?
e: Correct answer: Non-Proportional Reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd. is a company having surplus share capital as well as bank balance. The Company wants to balance both and benefit the shareholders. Suggest a solution for a company.
e: Correct answer: Buy-back of shares (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The accounting of an insurance company is not required to comply with which of the following regulations?

I. Banking Regulation Act, 1949
II. The Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015
III. Accounting Standards (AS) or Indian Accounting Standard (Ind-As), as the case may be, issued by the ICAI
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Information about an item is _________ if its omission or misstatement might influence the financial decisions of users taken on the basis of  such information.
e: Correct answer: Material (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What do you mean by premium deficiency?
o: The sum of expected claim costs, related expenses and maintenance costs in excess of the related reserve for unexpired risks is known as premium deficiency
The sum of reserve for unexpired risks in excess o
The amount of premium due but not received from th
The sum of unexpired risk over expected  claims  i
Premium charged to a customer after giving a no cl
e: Correct answer: The sum of expected claim costs, related expenses and maintenance costs in excess of the related reserve for unexpired risks is known as premium deficiency (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Credit rating issued by rating companies for long-term instruments is "BB". What does this imply about the credit worthiness of the instrument?

I. Moderate risk of default relating to timely servicing of financial obligations
II. High risk of default relating to timely servicing of financial obligations
III. Very high risk of default regarding timely servicing of financial obligations
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following are treated as investment assets for the purpose of regulating investments of a life insurer business?

I. Shareholders' funds representing solvency margin
II. Participating and Non-participating Policyholders funds
III. One year Renewable Group Term Insurance
IV. Non-unit reserves of unit linked insurance business
e: Correct answer: I, II, III and IV (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
PQR General Insurance Co Ltd gives the following details for 2009-10:

I. Gross Direct Premium Income Rs. 95 crore
II. Premium on Reinsurance Accepted Rs. 35 crore
III. Premium on Reinsurance Ceded Rs. 44 crore
IV. Net Premium for 2008-09 Rs. 92 crore

Calculate Net Premium Account.
e: Correct answer: Rs.89 crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Revenue Account shall be prepared in Form B- RA, Profit and Loss Account in Form B-PL and Balance Sheet in Form B-BS as per which of the following provisions?

I. Part V in schedule B of Reg.3
II. Part 111 of the IRDAI regulation
III. The Companies Act 1956
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).
